name: gdiplus
description: gdiplus-mini (ticket #94 / 0453): the flat GDI+ surface the ReactOS shimgvw viewer calls, over libpng/libjpeg/libnsgif/libnsbmp decode and gdi32's StretchBlt draw. A SEPARATE component from lib.json on purpose — it drags four image decoders in, and a win32 app that never touches an image must not pay for them.
